agent_data_note: Use the mounted PDCAT artifact at `dataset_candidate/pdcat-master/`. It bundles cBench (28 programs), PolyBench (30 kernels), author implementations of PDCAT/RIO/CFSCA/CompTuner/SRTuner, and precomputed results. Do not substitute toy C micro-benchmarks.
benchmark_rules: Baseline reference code lives under `dataset_candidate/pdcat-master/Algorithm/overall/` (PDCAT, RIO, CFSCA, CompTuner, SRTuner).
Primary metric: speedup ratio over GCC -O3 = (time_O3 - time_selected) / time_selected × 100%. Higher is better.
Paper time budgets are 1250 / 2500 / 5000 seconds per program with 5 repeats (median reported). Subset runs with shorter budgets are acceptable when documented.
The shared mount is read-only. Write binaries, logs, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.
Compile/run with system `gcc`/`g++` prepared by container_setup.sh (paper used GCC 13.1.0).
Do not claim full paper reproduction unless the experiment protocol and compute budget match.
non_goals: Re-downloading cBench/PolyBench from scratch when the PDCAT artifact already bundles curated copies
Running all 58 programs × 4 baselines × 3 budgets × 5 repeats in one autonomous session
Using fabricated synthetic programs instead of the mounted benchmarks
